$comment: Diagnostic catalogue for CML v0.1. Codes and severities MUST match the table in SPECIFICATION.md §18 (checked by scripts/validate.mjs). 'mvp' marks codes the parser MVP emits; 'status: reserved' codes are never emitted in v0.1.

diagnostics.title: Section keyword with no name
diagnostics.recovery: A new section with type null starts.

diagnostics.title: Unclosed repeat at end of file
diagnostics.recovery: Reported at the ||:. The collected measures form a repeat group with count 2.

diagnostics.title: Repeat end with no open repeat
diagnostics.recovery: The :|| is treated as | and any count is ignored.

diagnostics.title: Invalid repeat count
diagnostics.recovery: The count defaults to 2.

diagnostics.title: Malformed measure line boundaries
diagnostics.recovery: Content after the last bar is ignored. A line with fewer than two bars, or starting with :||, yields no measures.

diagnostics.title: Invalid chord root or bass note
diagnostics.recovery: The chord token is dropped; its measure is kept.

diagnostics.title: Ending marker outside a repeat group
diagnostics.recovery: Alternate endings are outside the parser MVP.

diagnostics.title: Repeat group spans a section boundary
diagnostics.recovery: Reported at the ||:. The group is closed at the section boundary with count 2.

diagnostics.title: Nested repeat group
diagnostics.recovery: The inner ||: is treated as |.

diagnostics.title: Unknown metadata key
diagnostics.recovery: Preserved in metadata as a string.

diagnostics.title: Malformed chord quality
diagnostics.recovery: Quality kept verbatim.

diagnostics.title: Lyric cell count differs from measure count
diagnostics.recovery: Lyrics are outside the parser MVP.

diagnostics.title: Explicit durations do not fill the bar
diagnostics.recovery: Not emitted in v0.1; durations are deferred.

diagnostics.title: Non-contiguous ending numbers
diagnostics.recovery: Alternate endings are outside the parser MVP.

diagnostics.title: Navigation marker not supported in v0.1
diagnostics.recovery: The line is skipped.

diagnostics.title: key and scale conflict
diagnostics.recovery: Reported on the later line; the later value wins.

diagnostics.title: Repeat marker in the middle of a measure line
diagnostics.recovery: The marker is treated as | and is not paired.

diagnostics.title: Plain double bar is reserved
diagnostics.recovery: Treated as |.

diagnostics.title: Digits-only parenthesized quality
diagnostics.recovery: Quality kept verbatim.

diagnostics.title: Property line after the body started
diagnostics.recovery: The line is skipped.

diagnostics.title: Reserved sigil
diagnostics.recovery: The line or token is skipped.

diagnostics.title: Unquoted property value contains spaces
diagnostics.recovery: The value is the rest of the line, trimmed.

diagnostics.title: Malformed property or section line
diagnostics.recovery: Unclosed quote or missing value: line dropped. Extra section tokens: section starts with name and label.

diagnostics.title: Lyric line with no preceding measure line
diagnostics.recovery: The lyric is not attached. Lyrics are outside the parser MVP.
